Markets.title: Bitcoin hits 6-week low, drops below $78,000 as Binance’s $6 billion hack rattles crypto markets. What should investors do?
Markets.summary: Bitcoin dropped more than 4% to a six-week low below $78,000 following a reported $6.3 billion security breach at Binance. Analysts advised investors to avoid panic selling and instead use staggered entries with smaller positions.

Markets.title: Coal India shares fall 3% after Q2 results; Jefferies, Motilal Oswal, others cut target price
Markets.summary: Coal India shares fell 3% despite a 57% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 6,547 crore. Following the results, major brokerages including Jefferies and Motilal Oswal adjusted their target prices for the stock.

Markets.title: Explained: Why AI giants Google, Amazon, Intel shares crashed up to 23% in a single day
Markets.summary: Alphabet, Amazon, and Intel shares plunged by up to 23% in a single day as investors grew concerned about surging AI spending and weaker cash flows. Alphabet's stock dropped over 13% after its third-quarter earnings missed Wall Street expectations due to slowing search advertising growth and heavy AI investments.

Markets.title: Equitas SFB shares tumble 27% in 2 days on CEO exit. More pain ahead?
Markets.summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank shares fell 27% over two sessions following the resignation of CEO and founder PN Vasudevan. Vasudevan stepped down due to a perceived conflict involving his daughter’s non-banking financial company.

Markets.title: Biggest crypto heist in history: How Binance’s $6 billion hack rattled markets and what it means for investors?
Markets.summary: Binance is investigating a suspected North Korea-linked security breach that caused an estimated $6.3 billion in losses. The exchange stated that user funds remain safe and pledged to cover all losses from the incident.

Markets.title: Global Market: Chinese yuan hits four-year high, heads for fourth straight monthly gain
Markets.summary: The Chinese yuan climbed to a four-year high against the US dollar, driven by strong exports and dollar sales by exporters. The currency is on track for its fourth consecutive monthly gain as the central bank signals comfort with its appreciation.

Geo-Political.title: Crypto giant Binance hit by $6.3bn hack suspected to be largest in history
Geo-Political.summary: Crypto exchange Binance suffered a $6.3 billion hack, believed to be the largest in history. Two analytics firms suspect that a North Korean hacking unit named TraderTraitor is responsible for the attack.

Geo-Political.title: Mushroom murderer fails to overturn convictions in Australian court challenge
Geo-Political.summary: Erin Patterson lost her court appeal after arguing that her murder trial involving poisonous mushrooms was unfair. Three appeal judges dismissed all seven grounds of her challenge to the convictions.

Geo-Political.title: Record number of purges as Xi emphasises 'party discipline' at China political gathering
Geo-Political.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping emphasized party discipline during a political gathering amid a record number of political purges. Observers state that this ongoing anti-corruption campaign is designed to consolidate and maintain his authority.

Geo-Political.title: Syrians struggle with soaring prices as crisis challenges post-Assad recovery
Geo-Political.summary: Syrians are facing severe discontent due to the end of government subsidies and soaring prices. This economic crisis is testing public support for Ahmed al-Sharaa's new administration as it attempts post-Assad recovery.

Geo-Political.title: Google value plunges by $500bn as AI fears rattle Wall Street
Geo-Political.summary: Google's stock fell to a six-month low after the company revealed that its new AI search summaries are negatively impacting advertising revenue. This decline wiped $500 billion from the tech giant's market value as investors grew concerned about the financial impact of artificial intelligence.

Geo-Political.title: Student-backed election winners demand sweeping resignations in Serbia
Geo-Political.summary: Following their recent electoral victory over Aleksandar Vučić's party, student-backed lawmakers in Serbia are demanding the resignations of top government officials. The newly elected Student List members want these sweeping departures to take effect immediately.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result for a relevant user query without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is emerging as a new method for generating organic traffic compared to traditional SEO.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide outlines the top 10 AI tools designed to help digital creators stay ahead of the curve in 2025. These essential technologies are revolutionizing the content creation process and making creators' lives easier.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that allows users to create various types of AI content. In addition to content creation, the platform offers features for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: Economy can sustain high-growth trajectory in FY27, recent GST reforms to help: Finmin review
Data & Insights.summary: The finance ministry's October review states that the economy can maintain a high-growth trajectory in FY27, supported by recent GST reforms. However, the Department of Economic Affairs warned that ongoing global uncertainties, such as elevated oil prices and inflation, require constant vigilance.

Data & Insights.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang names 3 countries leading in tech, manufacturing: Which are they? Does India make the list?
Data & Insights.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang identified the United States, China, and Taiwan as the world's leading nations in manufacturing and advanced technology, omitting India from the list. He noted that China's strength stems from combining industrial production with computer science.

Data & Insights.title: India’s public debt ratio to fall to 75.1% of GDP by FY32, only major emerging economy set for a decline: RBI DG
Data & Insights.summary: India's public debt-to-GDP ratio is projected to drop from 84.3% in fiscal year 2026 to 75.1% by fiscal year 2032. According to RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta, India is the only emerging market economy with a GDP over $1 trillion expected to reduce its public debt during this period.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth a tad slower at 6.7% in September, expansion led by manufacturing, electricity generation
Data & Insights.summary: Industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September from 8% in August. Strong performances in manufacturing and electricity generation drove the expansion despite a drop in mining.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet approves PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana for 2026-31 with  ₹7,395 crore outlay to strengthen Panchayat governance
Data & Insights.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved the ₹7,395.55 crore Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana for the 2026-31 period. The scheme aims to strengthen governance across more than 2.55 lakh Panchayats and benefit approximately 32 lakh elected representatives and functionaries.

Data & Insights.title: India's industrial output growth slows to 6.7% in September as manufacturing, consumer durables lose momentum
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September, missing the expected 7.3% rate due to weaker manufacturing, electricity, and a contraction in mining. Despite this monthly slowdown, total industrial production grew 6.8% during the April-September period, improving from 4.4% the previous year.

India.title: "IDBI Bank Handed To Us In Bad Shape": Nirmala Sitharaman Hits Back At Rahul Gandhi
India.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman defended the government's decision to sell IDBI Bank, stating the institution was handed over in poor condition. Her response followed Rahul Gandhi's criticism of the sale to a Canadian firm and his support for the bank's employees.

India.title: Will Keep Walking Till Congress Government Falls: Telangana BJP MP Launches Padayatra
India.summary: Telangana BJP MP Eatala Rajender started a march from Edulabad on October 27 to protest against alleged pollution from the Jawaharnagar dumping yard. He stated that he will continue walking until the Congress government in the state falls.

India.title: Uttar Pradesh Shuts Schools In Several Districts Due To Rain, Exam Today
India.summary: Schools in several Uttar Pradesh districts are closed due to heavy rain and the PET 2026 examination. Specifically, Gautam Buddh Nagar schools are shut for the exam, which is taking place across 32 centers in two shifts.

India.title: Opinion: Opinion | How India Is Making Its Stock Market An Expensive Place To Invest
India.summary: Foreign portfolio investors sold record amounts of Indian equities between 2025 and October 2026, driving foreign ownership of the Indian market to a 15-year low. This massive sell-off highlights how India's stock market has become an increasingly expensive place for investors.

India.title: 3 Rescued After Under-Construction Building Collapses In UP's Bulandshahr
India.summary: Three people were rescued after an under-construction building collapsed in Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh. The woman is in stable condition, and the two injured men were taken to a hospital for treatment.

India.title: Family Against 'Acting' Wish, Teen Jumps To Death From Greater Noida Building
India.summary: A teenager in Greater Noida jumped to his death from a building after his family opposed his wish to pursue acting. Police reported that the student had been upset about the disagreement for several days prior to the incident.

General.title: Australian mushroom murderer loses appeal to overturn convictions
General.summary: Erin Patterson has lost her appeal to overturn her murder convictions after three judges dismissed all seven of her arguments that the trial was unfair. Patterson was convicted of poisoning three people with death cap mushrooms.

General.title: Hyrox athlete who soiled herself in race says she put others at risk
General.summary: In her first interview since the incident, Hyrox athlete Joanna Wietrzyk acknowledged that she put others at risk by soiling herself during a race. She stated that she takes responsibility for her actions, but believes the severe backlash she received was unjustified.

General.title: China made Mbappé apologise - but many don't know exactly what he said
General.summary: Kylian Mbappé apologized after making a comment about Chinese leader Mao Zedong that sparked public anger. Due to strict internet censorship in China, many citizens remain unaware of his exact words.

General.title: Democrats have an identity crisis - it won't be an easy fix
General.summary: Regardless of the midterm election results, the Democratic Party is struggling to define its core values and leadership. These unresolved questions indicate that the party faces a difficult and complex path forward.

General.summary: Could the faithfuls finally come good in Thursday's penultimate episode?

General.title: Syrians struggle with soaring prices as crisis challenges post-Assad recovery
General.summary: Syrians are facing skyrocketing prices and the removal of government subsidies following the fall of Assad. This economic crisis is creating widespread discontent and testing public support for Ahmed al-Sharaa's new administration.
